import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,re
print('BUDGET',Path('search-budget.json').read_text());print('PLAN',Path('search-plan-1.json').read_text())
a=json.loads(Path('historical-results-allowlist.json').read_text()); print('TYPE',type(a).__name__)
blocked=re.compile(r'r403|r404|code-loop|polynexus|crown|tournament|transitive-bunkbed|bunkbed|hat[-_/]|formal',re.I)
ids=list(map(str,json.loads(Path('reservation.json').read_text())['ids'])); matches=[]; read=[]
for s in a:
 if blocked.search(s): continue
 p=Path(s); t=p.read_text(); read.append(s)
 if any(re.search(r'(?<!\d)'+mid+r'(?!\d)',t) for mid in ids):
  matches.append({'path':s,'text':t})
subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B','write_lane.py','history-review.json'],input=json.dumps({'read_paths':read,'matches':matches},indent=2),text=True,check=True,capture_output=True)
print('HISTORY',len(read),'MATCHES',json.dumps(matches)[:18000])
